svg.text: Two exact mechanisms in the order-three duality
Counting Haar on G; dual mass 1/3. Rows and columns are indexed 0, 1, 2.
(FC3): nonunital coefficients are allowed; the scalar matrices act as multipliers.
The shear makes the multiplicity coordinate stationary
(TC3)–(TC4), sampled exactly on G × G = (Z/3Z)²; every coordinate is modulo 3.
Colours and point labels mark q = 0, 1, 2. Basis translation increments x,t; after the shear only t increments.
